newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile shares end sharply higher on rate rumours.
newsitem.headline: Chile shares end sharply higher on rate rumours.

text.p: Chilean stocks rallied to a strong close on renwed speculation the Central Bank could soon lower interest rates, said dealers.
"As has happened in the last weeks, every Thursday and Friday rumours restart that the bank could cut interest rates by 0.25 percentage points," said one trader.
The blue-chip .IPSA index closed up 1.42 percent at 119.62 points. The general .IGPA index firmed 0.8 percent to 5,409.34 points amid turnover of 14.7 billion pesos.
Hopes of an interest rate cut were fuelled by media reports inflation could be 0.2-0.3 percent this month, down from one percent in April last year.
Analysts initally forecast inflation of up to 0.7 percent in April.
"The actual number is irrelevant, the point is the inflation numbers are coming down," said David Hurd, head of research at Merrill Lynch.
Winners include brewery CCU, up 2.89 percent at 1,780 pesos, forestry firm Masisa, up 2.17 percent at 235 pesos and power utility Enersis, which rose 1.25 percent at 263-1/4 pesos.
Losers included Banco Santander, down 0.82 percent at 30.25 pesos and copper firm Madeco, which lost 0.73 percent at 1,092 pesos.
